Observed numerical environment binds interpreter, numpy linalg binary, distribution metadata and fixed worker launch, not every OS or wheel file.
Candidates and source owners remain separate databases. Before/after fences withhold stale results; only native model head publication is an atomic CAS, not a distributed source/model transaction.
Actual host pressure sampler is used with isolated test scheduler state. Complete supervisor parent-to-child resource ownership is a separate RPI-022 qualification.
privacy: Only public fixture source, typed corpus, native theorem source/receipts, generation metadata, logs and hashes retained. No mutable databases, CAS directories, checkpoint tensors, scheduler state or private credentials.
